behaviors_covered.opto.photodiode_quantum_conversion: Complete non-default SI-constant oracle (hc/lambda at 500 nm, eta=0.6, 3 uW) with photon-rate energy conservation and per-carrier charge identities; power/efficiency scaling including admitted zero power and eta endpoints 0 and 1; wavelength doubling flips every output by the exact factor; every invalid boundary (nonpositive wavelength, eta outside [0,1], negative power) plus every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.opto.lambertian_target_irradiance: Complete hemisphere-projection oracle at 60/30 degree angles with exact cos-product symmetry under angle swap; inverse-square halving; zero-flux, axial, and exact pi/2 grazing endpoints whose one-ulp cosine residual is bounded by an explicitly justified absolute tolerance; every invalid boundary (negative flux/distance/angles, distance 0, angles one ulp past pi/2) plus all nonfinite inputs with recovery.
behaviors_covered.opto.layer_absorption_capture: Complete ln(2)/ln(4) optical-depth oracle (half absorbed in dead layer, quarter of remainder in active layer, eighth transmitted) with energy conservation; transparent, absent-layer, opaque and zero-power rows; tiny 1e-16 optical depth retained through expm1 without cancellation in either layer order; every negative input plus all nonfinite inputs with recovery; source-derived underflow defect reproduction asserting representable dimensional transmitted/absorbed power at optical depth 800.
behaviors_covered.opto.gaussian_aperture_capture: Complete Rayleigh-plane oracle (z=zR gives w=sqrt(2)w0, aperture=w0 encloses 1-e^-1) with peak-energy identity Iaxis*pi*w^2/2=P; signed-z invariance, z=0 waist plane, zero-power and zero-aperture rows; tiny-aperture disk-integral limit checked against Iaxis*pi*a^2; inclusive 0.1*pi paraxial endpoint verified exact at double precision and one-step-past endpoint rejected; all nonfinite inputs with recovery; source-derived underflow defect reproduction asserting representable captured power 2e-240 W when the squared aperture ratio underflows.
behaviors_covered.opto.step_index_mode_cutoff: Complete binary-exact oracle (200/128 and 199/128 indices give NA=sqrt(399)/128 with zero decimal cancellation); radius doubling scales V and cutoff by 2 and flips the margin sign; exact 2.405 crossing with roundoff-only margin tolerance; one-ulp index spacing against delta*(2n1-delta) identity; exact dyadic 1% contrast endpoint accepted and one-bit-lower cladding rejected; every invalid boundary plus all nonfinite inputs with recovery.
behaviors_covered.opto.fiber_gaussian_dispersion: Complete chirped-compression oracle (completing the square gives b=sqrt(1/5) for C=2, x=-0.4) with pulse-energy and FWHM-ratio identities; signed chirp, zero length, zero beta2, unchirped broadening, both signs of x with equal |b|, and zero admitted energy; every invalid boundary plus all nonfinite inputs with recovery.
behaviors_covered.opto.sipm_finite_cell_response: Complete one-seed-per-cell Poisson oracle (mean 1 leaves e^-1 of 300 cells dark) with fired/seed linearity-factor and per-avalanche charge identities; zero exposure and zero PDE keep the analytic unity response while fired cells and charge vanish; gain doubling rescales only charge; single-cell vector; 4e-17 photon exposure retained without underflow; saturation monotonicity of fired cells and the decreasing linearity factor including the exact 0.02 at u=50; every invalid boundary including fractional and one-ulp-off integer cells plus all nonfinite inputs with recovery.

oracle_provenance: Every expected value was derived independently of the catalog examples and implementation outputs: SI defining constants (h, c, q exact), closed-form hemisphere/Gaussian/Poisson/optical-depth integrals evaluated at exact binary-friendly arguments (200/128 indices, ln(2) depths, z=zR), and 70-digit Decimal cross-checks of every decimal literal. Guard endpoints were verified at double precision: the 0.1*pi paraxial ratio compares bit-equal, the 1% contrast boundary is the exact dyadic 0.015625/1.5625, and invalid probes one ulp past each limit were confirmed to trip the constraint. expm1/exprel small-argument and saturation behavior (including expm1(-50) rounding to -1 giving exactly 0.02) was checked to be platform-robust well inside 1e-12.
verification: Not executed. No builds, tests, lint, formatter, backend process or native launches. Independent f64/Decimal arithmetic only; all 28 Rust tests and 23 flat process scenarios await Main.
untested_gaps: Main must compile and run the opto integration target and the full integrated suite; no worker executed any code.
Main must run the 23 flat scenarios in one real JSON-lines process and confirm the two intentional failing defect reproductions fail exactly where predicted.
Diagram semantics and native pixel review are outside the tester lane; V2OptoRun owns them.
Engine behavior beyond the seven calculators (shared helper, other lanes) was not probed.

suspected_defects.location: backend/catalog/opto.json active_absorbed_power and transmitted_power expressions (plain exp of large optical depth)
suspected_defects.evidence: Source-derived, not executed. For optical depth >= ~745, exp(-depth) underflows to +0.0 (a finite value admitted by checked::evaluate), so incident_power*0.0 fabricates zero although the dimensional products are representable.
suspected_defects.observation: True values (70-digit Decimal): e^-800=3.6678745841776872e-348, so transmitted=P0*e^-801=1.34933565231422395e-48 W and active_absorbed=P0*e^-800*(1-e^-1)=2.31853893186346326e-48 W; the implementation returns 0 for both, violating the lane research rule that unrepresentable intermediates remain arithmetic errors rather than fabricated finite outputs. Reproducing test layer_preserves_dimensional_power_when_transmission_fraction_underflows asserts the representable values and is expected to fail (row 1: transmitted only).

suspected_defects.location: backend/catalog/opto.json captured_fraction/captured_power expressions (squared ratio underflows before expm1)
suspected_defects.evidence: Source-derived, not executed. With aperture_radius/beam_radius=1e-170, the square 1e-340 is below the smallest binary64 subnormal, so -expm1(-2*(a/w)^2) sees 0 and captured_power=beam_power*0.0 fabricates zero although the disk integral 2e-240 W is representable.
suspected_defects.observation: captured_fraction==0.0 is the correctly rounded true fraction (2e-340 itself is unrepresentable), but captured_power loses a representable product; research requires tiny fractions retained through expm1. Reproducing test gaussian_preserves_dimensional_power_when_capture_fraction_underflows asserts captured_power 2e-240 and is expected to fail on that one assertion only.

parent_desktop_scenarios.steps: Select the photodiode calculator in the native app, enter the complete non-default vector, confirm all four outputs render in their units, then set power 0 and confirm rate/current show admitted zeros while energy/responsivity stay.

Enter the 60/30 degree vector, confirm irradiance, then type 1.5707963267948968 into emission_angle and confirm an inline domain message without crashing; restore the valid angle and confirm recovery.
Enter the ln(2)/ln(4) vector, confirm the 4/3/1 mW split renders, then set active_thickness to a negative value and confirm rejection; restore and confirm recovery.
Enter the Rayleigh-plane vector, confirm outputs, flip axial_distance sign and confirm identical outputs, then enter wavelength 6.346017160251383e-05 and confirm the paraxial guard message.

Enter the binary-contrast vector, confirm the positive margin, set wavelength to 6e-06 to render the negative margin diagnostic with its sign, then set cladding_index 1.54 and confirm the contrast guard message.
Enter the chirped vector, confirm the compressed width below 2 ps and the boosted peak power, then set chirp 0 and confirm broadening instead of compression.

Enter the one-seed-per-cell vector, confirm fired cells below cell count, enter cell_count 1.5 and confirm the integer-cell message, then restore 300 and set photon_count 0 to confirm the analytic unity response with zero charge.
